{{Source citation|date=October 2019}}

[[File:Togo onsen01nt3200.jpg|thumb|280px|Example of a large facility:<br />{{ill|Tōgō Onsen|ja|東郷温泉|qid=Q11528535|lt=Togo Onsen}} YuaShisu Togo Ryuhokaku]]
'''Day-Use Bathing Facilities''' (日帰り入浴施設) are a type of {{ill|Public bathing|af|Baddens in Klassieke Tyd|ar|حمامات عامة|az|İctimai hamam|ca|Banys públics|cdo|Tŏng-diè-dáing|de|Badehaus|eo|Banejo|es|Baños públicos (historia)|eu|Bainuetxe publiko|fa|حمام عمومی|fi|Yleinen sauna|fr|Bains publics|he|בית מרחץ|id|Pemandian umum|is|Baðhús|ja|公衆浴場|jv|Jedhing umum|ko|목욕탕|lt|Garinė pirtis|nl|Badhuis|nn|Badehus|pt|Banho público|simple|Bathhouse|sv|Badhus|tr|Hamam|vi|Nhà tắm công cộng|zh|公眾浴場|zh_yue|浴堂|qid=Q785952|lt=Public Bathhouse}} designed for {{ill|Bathing|ar|استحمام|arz|حموم|ban|Manjus|bcl|Pagparigos|be|Купанне|bg|Баня (процедура)|bh|नहान|bn|স্নান|ca|Bany|cdo|Sā̤-tŏng|ckb|گەرماوکردن|cs|Lázeň|da|Bad|dag|Kom Subu|de|Badekultur|eo|Bano|es|Baño|eu|Bainu|fa|حمام کردن|fi|Kylpeminen|fr|Baignade|hak|Sé-sṳ̂n|he|רחצה|hi|स्नान|hyw|Լոգանք|id|Mandi|it|Bagno (immersione del corpo)|ja|入浴|jv|Adus|kk|Шомылу|kn|ಸ್ನಾನ|ko|목욕|ml|കുളി|ms|Mandi|ne|नुहाउनु|new|स्नान|nl|Baden (activiteit)|nn|Bading|no|Bading|or|ସ୍ନାନ|pt|Banho|ru|Купание|sh|Kupanje|simple|Bathing|sq|Banja|sr|Купање|sv|Bad|ta|குளித்தல்|te|స్నానం|th|การอาบน้ำ|tl|Paliligo|tr|Yıkanma|uk|Купання|ur|غسل|vi|Tắm|wuu|汏浴|zh|洗澡|zh_classical|沐浴|zh_min_nan|Sé-e̍k|zh_yue|洗身|qid=Q327651|lt=Bathing}} without involving {{ill|Lodging|af|Losiesverblyf|bn|আবাসন (লজিং)|fa|مکان‌های اقامتی|fr|Hébergement (voyage)|ga|Lóistín|he|הלנה (אירוח)|id|Penginapan|ja|宿泊|ki|Komaroka|ko|숙박|si|ලැගුම්හල්|simple|Lodging|th|ที่พัก|tr|Konaklama|qid=Q5056668|lt=accommodation}}. Facilities that primarily use {{ill|Onsen|ar|أونسن|az|Onsen|bcl|Onsen|ca|Onsen|cs|Onsen|da|Onsen|de|Onsen|el|Όνσεν|eo|Onsen|es|Onsen|et|Onsen|eu|Onsen|fa|اونسن|fi|Onsen|fr|Onsen|he|אונסן|hu|Onszen|id|Onsen|it|Onsen|ja|温泉|km|អុនសេន|ko|일본의 온천|la|Onsen|lt|Onsenas|lv|Onsens|ms|Onsen|my|အွန်းဆန်း|nl|Onsen|nn|Onsen|no|Onsen|pl|Onsen|pt|Onsen|ro|Onsen|ru|Онсэн|simple|Onsen|sk|Onsen|sl|Onsen|sv|Onsen|ta|ஒன்சென்|th|อนเซ็ง|tl|Onsen|tr|Onsen|uk|Онсен|ur|اونسن|vi|Onsen|zh|日本溫泉|qid=Q655311|lt=Onsen}} water are often also called '''Day-Use Onsen Facilities'''.

== Overview ==
The range of facilities spans from small establishments consisting only of a bath – resembling an extension of a {{ill|Communal hot springs|ja|共同浴場|qid=Q11392653}} used in daily routines – to large complexes that, in addition to a variety of bathtubs, include relaxation areas and dining services. Such large facilities increasingly emphasize comprehensive {{ill|Relaxation (psychology)|ar|استرخاء|fa|آرمش (روان‌شناسی)|he|רוגע|hu|Relaxáció|it|Rilassamento|ja|リラクゼーション (心理学)|kn|ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ|ko|휴식 (심리학)|pl|Relaks|ro|Relaxare|simple|Relaxation|sq|Relaksimi (psikologji)|sr|Опуштање|zh|放鬆 (心理學)|qid=Q3935810|lt=Relaxation}} and {{ill|Entertainment|de|Unterhaltung|ja|娯楽|zh|娱乐|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Entertainment|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=エンターテインメント|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=エンターテインメント|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=エンターテインメント|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q173799}} (amusement) offerings through the facility space, much like the concept seen in {{ill|Super Sentō|de|Super-Sento|ja|スーパー銭湯|zh|超级澡堂}}. In many cases the term is used especially for facilities that make use of hot spring water. However, in areas where natural hot springs do not emerge, some establishments use boiled {{ill|Well|en|Well|qid=Q43483|lt=Well}} water derived from {{ill|Mineral spring|en|Mineral spring|qid=Q1365924|lt=Mineral Spring}}, or even substitute with {{ill|Seawater|en|Seawater|qid=Q184395|lt=Seawater}} (or more precisely, {{ill|Marine Spring|de|Meeresquelle|ja|海洋泉|zh|海洋泉|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Marine Spring|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135500316}}). In addition, some urban facilities – and even the large public baths of {{ill|Hotel|de|Business-Hotel|ja|ビジネスホテル|zh|商务酒店|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Business Hotel|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=ホテル|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=ホテル|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=ホテル|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q27686}} chains or {{ill|Health club|en|Health club|qid=Q1065656|lt=Fitness Club}}s – have begun mixing {{ill|Bath Additive|en|Bath bomb|qid=Q2869238|lt=Bath Additive}} (such as {{ill|Sodium|en|Sodium|qid=Q658|lt=Sodium}} and {{ill|Sulfur|en|Sulfur|qid=Q682|lt=Sulfur}}) into boiled tap water or dissolving mineral-like ingredients (for example, {{ill|Radium|en|Radium|qid=Q1128|lt=Radium}} and other components) within a {{ill|Boiler|en|Boiler|qid=Q3195517|lt=Boiler}} to produce what is marketed as an '''{{ill|Artificial Hot Spring|de|Künstliche Onsen|ja|人工温泉|zh|人工温泉}}'''. Such facilities are gaining ground around urban areas and near {{ill|Amusement park|en|Amusement park|qid=Q194195|lt=Theme Park}}s.

Until the {{ill|1980s|en|1980s|qid=Q34644|lt=1980s}}, hot springs were considered to occur only in limited mountainous regions. However, since the {{ill|1990s|en|1990s|qid=Q34653|lt=1990s}}, advancements in {{ill|Boring (earth)|en|Boring (earth)|qid=Q12177444|lt=Borehole drilling}} ({{ill|Digging|en|Digging|qid=Q4232202|lt=Excavation}}) technology have enabled drilling to depths of roughly 1,500 {{ill|Metre|en|Metre|qid=Q11573|lt=m}} to 2,000 m, making it possible for hot springs to emerge even in the {{ill|Plain|en|Plain|qid=Q160091|lt=Plain}} areas. Since the {{ill|2000s|en|2000s|qid=Q35024|lt=2000s}}, there has been a significant rise in the opening of new facilities in urban settings. In rural regions, it is common to develop hot springs as part of a municipal {{ill|Community building|de|Stadtbelebung|ja|町おこし|zh|城镇振兴|lt=Town Revitalization|lt_ja=町興し|lt_de=Stadtbelebung|lt_zh=城镇振兴|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Town Revitalization|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=地域おこし|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=地域おこし|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=地域おこし|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q5154924}} strategy and to operate bathing facilities on a public ({{ill|Public Enterprise|de|Öffentlich|ja|公営|zh|公营|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Public|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=公営企業|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=公営企業|ja_comment=former now fixed redirect|3=公営企業|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11391959}}) basis, whereas in cities such facilities are also established by dedicated enterprises nationwide or as a component of real estate redevelopment by general companies within the leisure industry (for instance, attached to {{ill|Amusement park|en|Amusement park|qid=Q194195|lt=Theme Park}}s or {{ill|Pachinko Parlor|de|Pachinko-Laden|ja|パチンコ店|zh|柏青哥店|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Pachinko Parlor|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11328994|lt=Pachinko Parlors}}).

Facilities of this kind are found throughout various hot spring regions in the country – and in many cases there exist hot spring resorts consisting solely of day-use bathing facilities. This pattern is especially evident with new developments of {{ill|Hot Spring Source|de|Quelle des Onsen|ja|源泉|zh|温泉源}}. Examples include facilities built adjacent to {{ill|Train station|en|Train station|qid=Q55488|lt=Railway Station}}, along {{ill|Controlled-access highway|en|Controlled-access highway|qid=Q46622|lt=Highway}} {{ill|service area|de|Raststätte|ja|サービスエリア|zh|服务区|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Service Area|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q60985097|lt=service areas}}, or at {{ill|Roadside station|en|Roadside station|qid=Q1187691|lt=Roadside Station}}s; there are even cases where former {{ill|Ryokan|en|Ryokan|qid=Q562930|lt=Ryokan}}s have discontinued their lodging operations to function purely as day-use bathing facilities.

In recent years, the number of publicly operated day-use bathing facilities has also been increasing.
